title: Taxi Trips
body: The streets of Anytown, USA, are a perfect grid with every block exactly one tenth of a mile long. Taxi drivers only pick up and drop off at intersections. You have acquired a log of all 200,000 taxi trips in Anytown during $$2018$$, which includes measurements for the following $$3$$ variables: number of blocks, total distance, and fare. Taxi fare in Anytown is $2 per mile plus $3 per trip. Assume no measurement error and no missing values.
